Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

You have linked additional allocation directly to binding commitment; it sounds like demand certainty is essential to reserving capacity. We are ready to make a long-term commitment if you secure our full annual requirement. How can that commitment, together with flexibility on lead time, support a dependable allocation from you?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Our should-cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per 1 (cost:340010). Our demand forecast for Mechanical seal 24 mm is up +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 27.38 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We also checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge your commitment to a 36-month contract and the increased volume of 23,400 units. The extended lead time of 56 days assists our production planning, allowing us to secure this allocation despite our high utilization. 

However, your target price is unrealistic; we can offer €31.70 per unit under these revised terms. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot remains valid for 7 days. Our offer comprises a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
